items.title: The sign sheaf on the quotient by a free finite group action, identifying invariant sections on the cover with sections twisted by the character
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the rank one locally free sign sheaf attached to a character of a free finite group action on an algebraic space, and identifies the $\chi$-invariant sections over the cover with the sections of the twisted sheaf over the quotient (statement lines 1145-1159). The proof uses the torsor structure to recognise the pushforward of the constant sheaf as finite locally free with $G$-action, computes stalks and a projection formula, cuts out the character eigensheaf and identifies the semi-invariants at the level of stalks. The eigensheaf construction and the stalk identification are the substance, so the claim is H2.
